anti_patterns_observed_this_session.pattern: matplotlib suptitle abuse for caption text
anti_patterns_observed_this_session.description: Several figures (A4, A25, A26) were using fig.suptitle to embed multi-sentence caption text inside the figure title bar. This renders as a giant text block at the top of the figure, separate from the LaTeX caption (which then duplicates the information). Captions belong in LaTeX \caption{}, not matplotlib suptitle.
anti_patterns_observed_this_session.prevention: Keep matplotlib suptitle to one short line. Push all explanatory text to the LaTeX \caption{} block.

anti_patterns_observed_this_session.description: AIChE Journal uses 2-column layout. A table wider than 1 column placed in \begin{table} creates a single-column float that forces surrounding text to wrap around it, often interleaving prose into table cells (page 54 here had §A.6 'Additional Figures' text running into Artifact reference table R-rows). Wide tables MUST be \begin{table*}.
anti_patterns_observed_this_session.prevention: Any supp table with width > 0.5 linewidth or > 4 columns should be \begin{table*}. Visually check after any 2-column-layout change.

anti_patterns_observed_this_session.pattern: Cumulative integration of biased log-returns explodes visualization
anti_patterns_observed_this_session.description: Reconstruction figures take a contiguous 777-point gen_log_delta sequence and cumulative-integrate to OD. Any non-zero mean bias in gen_log_delta compounds exponentially over 777 steps. WGAN-CNN seed-42 produces ~1e46 reconstructed OD — completely off-scale, crushing the real-OD trace at any autoscaled axis. Solution: y-axis clipping with explicit off-scale text annotation.
anti_patterns_observed_this_session.prevention: Whenever a metric/figure involves cumulative integration or compound multiplicative operations over long sequences, decide on a display window from real-data scale and clip generated traces to it with an explicit overflow indicator.
